description: Wallet monitoring for agents: watch an EVM address and get only what changed since your last call: native coin and token balance deltas (USDC always included, up to 10 more tokens) and the number of outgoing transactions. Read directly from the blockchain. First call saves a baseline and returns a cursor; pass it on the next call. For treasury and payment tracking, whale and smart-money watching, deposit detection. Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon. Params: address, chain (default base), tokens (list of ERC-20 contracts), min_change_pct (ignore smaller balance moves), cursor. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"address":"0x622efA6Ceb83a5b6EdBC931332f4db68B7f74F27","chain":"base"}.

cursor.description: Cursor from your previous call; omit on the first call

min_change_pct.description: Only report balance changes of at least this percentage

tokens.description: Extra ERC-20 contracts to track (USDC is always included)

name: wallet_watch
title: Wallet Activity Monitor (balance changes, outgoing tx)
